title: FancyZones High GPU usage in case any Window is set to "Always on Top"
summary: FancyZones reportedly uses substantial GPU while idle after window manipulation when a topmost window is present.

judgment.rationale: The scenario requires a discriminating comparison before the failing boundary can be established.
evidence: On 0.89.0 the reporter saw 15–20% GPU after resizing a window with Task Manager set Always on Top, and supplied a screenshot.
The reporter answered the maintainer’s GPU question: ASUS Zephyrus G14 with GTX 1650 Ti; a maintainer could not reproduce on an Nvidia 3060.
Other participants report continued usage and share a restart workaround; a later participant supplied a clip.
Inspected src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/WorkArea.cpp: SetWorkAreaWindowAsTopmost calls SetWindowPos relative to the dragged window or HWND_TOPMOST; this alone does not establish a GPU cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported sequence on a current build and isolate the failing boundary.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction or supported behavior investigation may be applicable after resolving the identified uncertainty.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate FancyZones idle GPU usage with topmost windows
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Overlay composition or z-order interaction could contribute, but the reported correlation is not a demonstrated root cause.
plan: Reproduce the supplied sequence on a current build and compare with no topmost window.
Measure GPU activity and overlay/window lifecycle after dragging or resizing, including different GPU hardware where available.
Fix the demonstrated rendering or lifecycle cause without regressing snapping and z-order.
Add focused regression coverage for the affected lifecycle and verify the GPU idle behavior manually.
verification: GPU usage returns to the idle baseline after a completed operation.
Dragging, snapping and topmost windows continue to behave correctly.

confidence.rationale: The reported failure boundary and current behavior are not yet established.

reproduce.title: Investigate FancyZones idle GPU usage with topmost windows
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare with the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a suitable Windows test environment and preserve existing user data and settings.
setup: Enable FancyZones on a Windows test machine; open Task Manager with its Always on Top option.
steps: 1. Measure FancyZones GPU usage at idle before interacting with windows.
2. Resize or zone a window while Task Manager is topmost, then release and wait for idle.
3. Compare GPU activity after disabling Task Manager Always on Top and after a FancyZones restart.
4. If reproducible, inspect FancyZones overlay and window activity and compare a second GPU if available.
reproduce.expected_result: FancyZones returns to its normal idle GPU baseline after a completed window operation.
